name: Bake Me Into Your Heart
source:
Bake Me Into Your Heart is a visual novel dating simulator where instead of dating people you are getting over a rough breakup by talking to pastries.

[From [url=https://amandakirk.itch.io/bake-me-into-your-heart-demo]itch.io[/url]]
